newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Telecom sells US$48mln stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: Star Telecom sells US$48mln stake in unit.

text.p: Paging services operator Star Telecom International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has agreed to sell a 40 percent stake in its wholly-owned Star Digitel Ltd to U.S.-based third party International Wireless Communications Inc for US$48 million.
Star Digitel is responsible for the development of Star Telecom's cellular phone business in China and has interests in various telecommunication projects in provinces in China.

Star Telecom said the capital injection would provide financial resources to develop Star Digitel's cellular business in connection with the Great Wall Mobile Telecom Plan which China announced last year.
The company said US$34 million would be used to finance development of Star Digitel's existing and future cellular projects with remaining going to working capital.
California-based International Wireless Communications specialises in development, operations and management of wireless communications firms and projects in emerging markets, Star Telecom said.
Shares of Star Telecom rose HK$0.15 or 5.22 percent to HK$3.025 in early trade after resumed trading on Wednesday.
